messages:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a config-only deploy at 02:00 UTC in the nightly change window. No model binaries changed. We'll do routing weight tweaks, per-route token limits, and tighten the batching window to reduce tail latency. Canaries 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~10m steps. Please watch p95/p99, errors, and cost metrics. :eyes:
sam: ACK. Which routes are affected? Any customer-facing routes we should flag?
maria: A few infra routes and the public /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints for low-priority tier. Not touching paid-reserved routes. Full list: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings (low_pct), internal/async-infer.
lee: We'll pin the canary to model-variant: v2.1-quant-pin to avoid cross-variant fallbacks during the test. Not changing fallback policy otherwise.
maria: Correct — pin for the canary only, then unpin after stabilization. Also enabling a small KV TTL bump to help hot prefixes.
jamie: Small note: I'm increasing batching max_window from 40ms -> 25ms (to trim p99) and lowering max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 1536. Expected token cost impact negligible but should drop tail latency.
maria: Config snippet for the canary set (cfg-2026-03-20-01):
```yaml
canary: true
routing:
  /v1/generate: {weight: 0.05}
  /v1/chat: {weight: 0.05}
  internal/async-infer: {weight: 0.05}
limits:
  per_route:
    /v1/generate: {max_tokens_per_min: 120000}
    /v1/chat: {max_tokens_per_min: 90000}
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1536
  max_wait_ms: 25
  batch_mode: continuous
kv_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 120
model_pin: "v2.1-quant-pin"
metrics: [p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_cost]
rollback_triggers:
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  p99_latency_ms: 500
  sustained_window_minutes: 5
```
sam: Rollback plan acknowledged. To be explicit: if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p99 > 500ms for 5m, we run `deploy-bot rollback cfg-2026-03-20-01` and revert routing weights to previous set.
oncall: I'll monitor and alert if any spike. Setting a temporary alert for p99 > 400ms just for a safety margin.
deploy-bot: Canary start: cfg-2026-03-20-01 -> 5% traffic. Started at 02:00:00 UTC. Logs: https://logs.redwood/cfg-2026-03-20-01
oncall: 02:06 — p95 stable, p99 small blip ~470ms but not sustained. Watching. :thumbsup:
sam: Good. Keep an eye on error_rate; we saw a tiny bump with last night's similar tweak. If it creeps, we abort.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 20% traffic at 02:10:00 UTC. Observability checks passed (throughput, errors, token_cost).
jamie: Observing token cost down ~1.7% on the canary slice, p99 improved ~12% for these routes. Nice.
lee: No customer-facing incidents seen. Pin works as expected — no cross-variant evictions.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% started at 02:20:00 UTC. Will mark complete once health-checks pass for 10m.
oncall: Temporary alert cleared. Post-canary dashboards look green.
maria: If anything odd after 100% roll, immediate rollback per sam's triggers. Otherwise I'll update release notes and close the window at 03:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 02:30:10 UTC -> cfg-2026-03-20-01 applied to 100% traffic. No active rollback.
maria: Thanks team. I'll add a short blurb in release notes: "Config-only: tightened batching window, smaller batch size, per-route token limits, KV TTL bump, routing weight adjustments; net effect lower p99 and slightly lower token cost." Follow-up doc will include perf graphs.
sam: +1.
jamie: :tada:
lee: leaving the model_pin in config history for traceability. We'll unpin in 48h unless we see regression.
maria: Closing thread — reaching out if any late regressions. Cheers. :rocket:
